findings.label: validation
findings.failure_mode: validate-pack.sh only checks heading presence; a pack with all 5 headings verbatim but a defect the TODO'd checks would catch (unclosed wiring fence, malformed label-probes row, unknown label, unquoted citation, bad brief syntax) is accepted as valid (exit 0), contradicting the exit-1 expectation tests/run.sh asserts for those exact fixtures shipped in the same diff.
evidence: .claude/skills/pr-review/scripts/validate-pack.sh:22-24 — TODO admits the other 5 checks are unimplemented
tests/packs/bad-wiring-unfenced.md — all 5 headings present verbatim despite its real defect
bash tests/run.sh reports FAIL for 5 of 6 bad-*.md fixtures because the validator returns exit 0

findings.label: validation
findings.failure_mode: git rev-parse --show-toplevel failing (non-git checkout) leaves ROOT as an empty string unchecked (set -u doesn't flag an assigned-empty var), so VALIDATOR/PACKS resolve to filesystem-root paths and every check call fails with an opaque 'No such file or directory' instead of a clear, documented exit.
evidence: tests/run.sh:5 — ROOT="$(git rev-parse --show-toplevel)" with no || guard
.claude/skills/pr-review/scripts/build-artifacts.sh:22 — sibling script guards the identical call with || { echo "error: not inside a git repository" >&2; exit 2; }
tests/run.sh:6-7 — VALIDATOR/PACKS built from the unguarded ROOT
tests/run.sh:22-28 — every check call then fails against a root-of-filesystem path with no diagnostic

findings.label: duplication
findings.failure_mode: A pack missing one of the 5 required section headings is checked with a hand-copied grep -qxF loop over a hardcoded 5-heading list, duplicating the identical loop already present in build-artifacts.sh (a pre-existing sibling script), with its own separately-worded failure message — the two copies can drift on what they check and how they report it on the next edit to either file.
evidence: .claude/skills/pr-review/scripts/build-artifacts.sh:52 — for h in "## Stack scope prefixes" ... ; do grep -qxF "$h" "$PACK" || MISSING_HEADINGS=... — the original 5-heading exact-match loop, already present before this diff

.claude/skills/pr-review/scripts/validate-pack.sh:24 — for h in "## Stack scope prefixes" ... ; do grep -qxF "$h" "$PACK" || fail "missing or renamed heading: $h" — the identical loop and list hand-copied into a new file

.claude/skills/pr-review/scripts/validate-pack.sh:21 — fail() { echo "invalid: $1"; INVALID=1; } — the second copy's own independent reporting path, free to diverge from build-artifacts.sh's wording and behavior
